scene_rule_summary.scope: 228 distinct episodes received targeted coarse scene reinspection: 148 transfer/lid/drawer candidates, plus a full6600 annotation search yielding 82 opened-receiver candidate episodes (2 overlapping). Opening context supports 74 additional mission merges across 69 episodes. All atomic annotations and fine-review status preserved.
scene_rule_summary.rule: Retain the unique-next-target rule using the visible scene and preceding actions. When an earlier action opens a particular container, merge later pickup with placement into that same prepared receiver; retain opening, closing and each distinct object transfer separately. Merge repeated spoonfuls only between the same uniquely identified source and receiver. Merge compatible lid closure and removal with adjacent release. Competing receivers without disambiguating history, generic returns and arbitrary object sequences remain separate.

opened_receiver_audit.rule: Opening a specific receiving container supplies context for merging pickup and placement into that same container. Opening stays separate; distinct object transfers remain separate.
